title: Private deployment release ops & enablement playbook — RBAC, Audit, KMS
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an operational playbook and coordinated release plan for Private/VPC/on-prem rollout of RBAC, audit logging, and KMS integrations. Deliverables: coordinated release notes, runbooks for SRE/solutions, enablement assets for customer success and sales, compliance checklist for SOC/ISO review, and a staged rollout plan with clear rollback criteria. Primary objective is to ensure customers can adopt Private features with predictable security posture and minimal integration friction.
goals: Publish consolidated release notes with security and upgrade guidance
Ship runbooks for SRE and customer ops covering RBAC schema migration and audit log ingestion
Provide KMS integration templates and troubleshooting playbooks for common HSM/KMS providers
Coordinate enablement sessions and one-pagers for customer success and sales
Verify compliance artifacts (dataflow diagrams, audit trail mapping) for internal audit and enterprise customers
milestones: 2025-10-20: Draft release notes and security summary
2025-11-03: Runbook beta delivered to SRE and SEs
launch_checklist: Finalize release notes: features, upgrade instructions, breaking changes
Publish RBAC migration guide with CLI examples
Provide KMS integration templates (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and HSM notes
Ship audit-log schema and recommended ELK/Kafka connector configs
Create customer-facing security FAQ and compliance matrix
Prepare rollback plan and validation tests for canary customers
Confirm support rota and escalation paths for first 30 days post-GA
rollout_strategy: Phase 1 — Internal beta: Redwood engineering and SE teams validate runbooks
Phase 2 — Partner canary: 3 enterprise customers on Dedicated with opt-in schedule
Phase 3 — Gradual GA: region-based enablement and tenant opt-in over 2 weeks
Fallback: automatic downgrade to hosted-compatible configs if KMS handshake fails
Acceptance gating: successful RBAC policy enforcement tests and audit log delivery verification
communications_plan: Internal announcement in #product and #sre with links to runbooks and playbook
Customer release notes sent to enterprise contacts with upgrade checklist
Enablement webinar for CS and Sales (recording + slides)
Dedicated help center article and troubleshooting KB
Postmortem and lessons learned channel to be created after GA window
qa_acceptance_criteria: RBAC: role bindings applied and validated against test policies for Admin/Owner/Viewer
Audit logs: events for token issuance/revocation and RBAC changes are emitted and delivered to configured sink
KMS: key rotation and envelope encryption verified with at least two providers
Upgrade path: existing private customers can upgrade without losing keys or audit history
Docs: release notes, runbooks, and KB articles published and linked from Console release modal
risks: KMS provider-specific behavior could require per-customer runbook edits
RBAC schema migration may require one-time DB migration causing short read-only window
Audit-log volume spikes may expose performance issues in Dedicated clusters
Incomplete enablement could lead to misconfigured keys and customer downtime
Regulatory reviews (SOC/ISO) may delay GA for certain customers
